organization.name: 2Connect

home.title: Volunteer opportunities for young people in Kenya
home.description: 2Connect connects young people in Kenya with volunteer opportunities that fit their skills, with free training, wellness support and campus clubs.
home.social_description: Your action. Your impact. Join young Kenyans volunteering in their communities, getting trained and growing as leaders with 2Connect.

about.label: About
about.title: About us, a youth volunteering movement in Kenya
about.description: 2Connect is a youth-led volunteering movement started in Nairobi in 2023. Read our story, our mission and values, and a note from founder Kevin Wanjiru.
about.social_description: More than volunteering, a movement. How 2Connect brings young Kenyans and the communities that need them together, and stays with both.

services.label: What we do
services.title: Volunteering, training, wellness and attachments
services.description: Volunteer matching, 2CFP volunteer training, free wellness and peer support, attachments, NGO partnerships and impact campaigns for young Kenyans.
services.social_description: Six ways in: get matched to volunteer work that fits you, get trained, get support, and lead on your campus. Pick your way in with 2Connect.

volunteerMatching.label: Volunteer matching
volunteerMatching.title: Volunteer matching, find volunteer work that fits you
volunteerMatching.description: Tell 2Connect what you are good at, what you care about and when you are free. We match young people in Kenya with volunteer work that fits.
volunteerMatching.social_description: Your skills, your cause, your schedule. Find volunteer work in Kenya that fits you, and let 2Connect connect you to it.

volunteerManagement.label: Volunteer management
volunteerManagement.title: Volunteer management for NGOs and community groups
volunteerManagement.description: Bring volunteers on board, place them, check them in, verify their work and count real hours. Volunteer management for organisations in Kenya.
volunteerManagement.social_description: Know who showed up, what got done and whether it was checked. Volunteer management for NGOs, community groups and campus clubs in Kenya.

events.label: Events
events.title: Volunteer events, cleanups and workshops in Kenya
events.description: Join community cleanups, youth wellness workshops, campus leadership trainings and volunteer meetups across Kenya. Find a 2Connect event and show up.
events.social_description: Your weekend, sorted. Cleanups, workshops, trainings and meetups with young people who care like you do. Find your next 2Connect event.
